title: LLM Correction Output (v1)
description: Hard contract for the LLM's structured output, validated runtime per Constitution Article IV. Free-form fallback is forbidden.

annulment_reason_pt_br.description: Required only when 'annulled' is in eliminatory_flags.

final_score.description: Must equal c1.score + c2.score + c3.score + c4.score + c5.score. Verified by the pipeline after JSON-Schema validation; mismatch counts as a schema failure.

excerpt.description: Verbatim substring of the submitted essay (after whitespace normalization). The pipeline verifies substring presence; failure counts as a schema failure.

improvement_path_pt_br.description: Required (non-null string) when score < 200; null or absent when score == 200. Conditional enforced by pipeline.
